# Star Advantage: Employee Value Creation and Capture in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Matthew L. Call, Kaifeng Jiang, C. Idso  
**Year:** 2026  
**Journal:** Human Resource Management  
**DOI:** [10.1002/hrm.70023](https://doi.org/10.1002/hrm.70023)

**Keywords:** artificial intelligence, star employees, value creation, human resource management, employee value capture

## Abstract

Examines how artificial intelligence reshapes the dynamics of star employee value creation and capture, exploring whether AI amplifies or diminishes the performance advantage of top-performing employees in organizations.
